title: Blankenfelder Straße, Berlin
description:
This beautiful house on the north of Berlin, has a fully furnished double room available for a female tenant to join in its friendly co-living atmosphere. The room is divided in 14 m2 with private sofa and table with chairs and 6 m2 for the bed. The city center is easily accessible via bus, tram, or train (45min. to Friedrichstrasse). And after work, come and get some stress relief going for walks in this quiet neighborhood, enjoying its fields, horses, and small gardens. It also makes a great place for home office! 

The rent includes electricity, water, heating, and wifi, the spacious upscale bathroom and kitchen offer a touch of luxury and are equipped for all your needs.

In summer you can enjoy the large back garden with its peaceful lotus-covered pond, observe frogs jumping in, and hear the birds singing. Supermarkets and restaurants are all within walking distance.

title: Schräger Weg, Berlin
description:
Ein vollmöbliertes Studio-Apartment im Dachgeschoss eines kleinen Mehrfamilienhauses (zwei Vollgeschosse und das Dachgeschoss). Die Kochecke verfügt über alles nötige: ein Backofen, vier Cerankochfelder, eine Geschirrspülmaschine, eine Kaffeemaschine, einen Kühlschrank, eine Waschmaschine und einen Trockner. Auch Geschirr, Besteck und Kochtöpfe.
Es gibt eine Schlafecke (1,80x2m), die mit einer dunklen Gardine vom Wohnbereich abgetrennt ist, ein Schlafecksofa und eine Abstellkammer. Vor der abschließbaren Wohnungstür kann der Hausflur und die Treppe für die Garderobe und Schuhe genutzt werden. 
Der Internetanschluss im Haus hat eine Geschwindigkeit von 175 MBit.
Haustiere und Raucher sind unerwünscht.
Zum Bus sind es ca. 5 Minuten. Die S-Bahnstation Berlin-Karow ist 10 Gehminuten entfernt. Von dort aus erreicht man in 12 Minuten den Bahnhof Gesundbrunnen, in 21 Minuten den Bahnhof Friedrichstraße und in 22 Minuten das Brandenburger Tor. 
Es ist eine sehr ruhige und grüne Hauptstadtecke mit meist Ein- bzw. Zweifamilienhäusern.

title: Rosenthaler Weg, Berlin
description:
First occupancy in a top location! 123 m2 of modern living comfort:

4 bright rooms, spacious floor plan

Balcony + access to green communal garden

High-quality fitted kitchen incl. appliances

Modern bathroom + guest toilet

Elevator, 2 cellar rooms, underground parking place

Family-friendly: daycare center directly opposite, schools & parks in 5 minutes on foot. Supermarkets, doctors, cafes in the immediate vicinity.
Perfect connection by bus and tram – quickly in the city centre.

title: Tiriotstraße, Berlin
description:
✔️ 14 m2 private bedroom - UNFURNISHED! Living room and kitchen comes with furniture
✔️ Shared with one professional (owner) who mostly works from home
✔️ Large 30 m2 living room with balcony and fully equipped modern kitchen (oven, microwave, fridge, stove, etc.)
✔️ Two bathrooms (7 m2 & 9 m2) with WC for comfortable shared living
✔️ Excellent public transport connections – tram & bus stops right outside; Rewe & Netto supermarkets 3 min walk away

🛋️ About the Apartment
The apartment is modern and spacious, offering a comfortable living environment with a big living room, a balcony, and a brand-new kitchen featuring all major appliances. Please note: the bedroom for rent is not furnished, so you can design and furnish it according to your taste.

📍 Location
Situated at Tiriotstraße 30, 13127 Berlin, Französisch Buchholz, the location offers quick access to public transport and shopping facilities. You can check the area on Google Maps for a better view.

👤 About Me
I’m from India and work as a professional, mostly from home. Further details can be discussed via the chat if you’re interested in moving in.
